title: Australia posts second-quarter growth of 2.1%, beating expectations
summary: Australia's GDP growth of 2.1% in Q2 exceeded expectations, providing the RBA with room to continue monetary tightening efforts. This strong economic performance supports the central bank's inflation-fighting strategy through interest rate increases.
content: The GDP print will allow the Reserve Bank of Australia room to go ahead with its policy tightening as it seeks to curb inflation.

zh.title: 澳大利亚第二季度增长2.1%，超越预期
zh.summary: 澳大利亚第二季度GDP增长2.1%超过预期，为澳储行继续实施货币紧缩提供了空间。这种强劲的经济表现支持央行通过提高利率来对抗通胀的战略。

title: Stock futures are little changed after Wall Street posts third straight losing day: Live updates
summary: U.S. stock futures remained relatively flat following Wall Street's third consecutive down day, signaling investor uncertainty. The continued weakness reflects broader market concerns amid economic headwinds.
content: The three major indexes posted their third down day on Tuesday.

zh.title: 华尔街连续第三天下跌后，股指期货涨跌不大：实时更新
zh.summary: 在华尔街连续第三天下跌后，美股期货保持相对平稳，表明投资者的不确定性。持续的疲软反映了在经济逆风中更广泛的市场担忧。

title: Japanese green tea giant Ito En surges 8%, defying a broad market sell-off
summary: Ito En's stock surged 8% following strong fiscal first-quarter results, defying a broader market downturn in Japanese equities. The outperformance highlights investor confidence in the green tea producer despite regional weakness.
content: Ito En shares surged, bucking a broader sell-off in Japanese stocks following its fiscal first-quarter results.

zh.title: 日本绿茶巨头伊藤园上涨8%，逆势而上
zh.summary: 伊藤园股票在强劲的财年第一季度业绩后上涨8%，逆转了日本股市的整体下滑。这一超额表现突显了投资者对这家绿茶生产商的信心，尽管该地区面临疲软。

title: Trump says U.S. is not forcing Iran to negotiate after fresh round of strikes
summary: The U.S. conducted fresh strikes against Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps sites, with Trump stating the nation is not forcing Iran into negotiations. The ongoing military action signals heightened geopolitical tensions in the Middle East.
content: U.S. forces completed another wave of strikes against Iran on Tuesday stateside, hitting multiple Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps sites across the country.

zh.title: 特朗普称美国不强迫伊朗在新一轮打击后进行谈判
zh.summary: 美国对伊朗革命卫队网站进行了新一轮打击，特朗普表示美国不强迫伊朗进行谈判。这一持续的军事行动表明中东地缘政治紧张局势加剧。

title: Apple Maps renames Lake Ontario as Lake America after Trump order
summary: Apple Maps has renamed Lake Ontario to Lake America following a Trump administration order, joining Google in the relabeling effort. The move reflects political pressure on tech companies to comply with government directives.
content: The iPhone maker follows rival technology giant Google in relabelling the Great Lake.

zh.title: 苹果地图遵从特朗普命令将安大略湖更名为美洲湖
zh.summary: 苹果地图遵从特朗普政府命令将安大略湖更名为美洲湖，与谷歌的重新标记工作相呼应。这一举动反映了政治压力促使科技公司遵守政府指令。

title: Fake 10 Downing Street listing exposes 'unfit' Booking.com, says consumer group
summary: A fake 10 Downing Street listing on Booking.com exposed significant platform governance issues, according to consumer advocacy groups. Booking.com dismissed the incident as a limited test, raising questions about verification standards and platform safety.
content: Booking.com said the "limited test" was "not a true reflection of the experience of millions of listings or reviews".

zh.title: 虚假唐宁街10号房源暴露Booking.com"不合格"问题，消费者组织指出
zh.summary: 根据消费者倡导组织的说法，Booking.com上一条虚假的唐宁街10号房源暴露了该平台的重大治理问题。Booking.com将该事件否认为有限的测试，引发了对验证标准和平台安全性的质疑。

title: Palo Alto Networks’ stock falls despite strong AI cybersecurity demand
summary: Despite beating earnings expectations and CEO Nikesh Arora citing strong AI-driven cybersecurity tailwinds, Palo Alto Networks' stock declined post-earnings. The pullback reflects investor concerns despite favorable business fundamentals and market demand.
content: Enterprise cyber threats and AI adoption are giving Palo Alto Networks ‘durable tailwinds,’ according to CEO Nikesh Arora, but the stock retreated after an earnings beat

zh.title: 尽管AI网络安全需求强劲，Palo Alto Networks股价下跌
zh.summary: 尽管超过收益预期，CEO Nikesh Arora指出AI驱动的网络安全强势，Palo Alto Networks在财报发布后股价下跌。这种回调反映了投资者的担忧，尽管业务基本面和市场需求良好。

title: Hugging Face's new duck robot is selling fast. A Chinese chip powers it
summary: Hugging Face's French subsidiary Pollen Robotics' Microduck robot has sold over 10,000 units since Thursday launch, powered by a Chinese chip. The rapid sales success highlights growing consumer demand for robotics across markets.
content: The colorful "Microduck" robot from HuggingFace's French subsidiary Pollen Robotics has sold more than 10,000 units since launching on Thursday.

zh.title: Hugging Face的新款鸭形机器人销售火爆，由中国芯片驱动
zh.summary: Hugging Face的法国子公司Pollen Robotics的Microduck机器人自周四推出以来已售出超过10,000台，由中国芯片驱动。快速的销售成功突显了全球消费者对机器人的需求不断增长。
